sets.name: Radio
sets.desc: A Radio Button allows users to select a single option from a group, supporting different states for interaction.

sets.name: Radio Label
sets.desc:
A radio button lets users choose one option from a group of options. When they pick one, any previously selected option is deselected. This way, users can only select one option at a time.
 
Radio buttons are commonly used in forms and surveys when users need to pick just one choice from a list.

doc: Radio groups let people select a single item from a short list. Use radio group in layouts that offer enough space to list up to five options, or if it’s important to view all options at once. If there isn’t enough space, try a dropdown or a select instead. If you need to let people select more than one option, try a checkbox. To let them immediately turn a setting on or off, try a switch.
